notes:
- **A cleaner, more focused look**: a denser workspace with a new title bar (project switcher, search and the page's actions in one place), a slim page header, and a status strip along the bottom. Files & Code gets a docked Console, Gradle Build and Agent Activity panel with a prompt bar.
- **Coin usage**: the new Coin card in the sidebar opens a breakdown of where your Coins went - per feature (Assistant, Texture Studio, 3D Studio, Version Converter and more) and per day. When you're signed in it matches your account page on the website.
- **Coins everywhere**: the cost of each AI request also appears in the Build & Run log and the activity list.
- **Plugin builds fix themselves**: a plugin set up with Maven (pom.xml) is converted to a Gradle build automatically, an outdated Shadow plugin ("Unsupported class file major version") is updated, and the plugin is compiled for the Java its Minecraft version's server runs - all without AI and without Coins.
- **Stop from the Assistant**: while the game, a build or a server runs, the Run button on the Assistant page turns into Stop.
